title: Absolute Value of the Symplectic Weil Character
body_html:
Absolute Value of the Symplectic Weil Character

Let $(E,j)$ be a symplectic space over a finite field $k$ of odd order, and let $s \in S(E,j)$. The absolute value of the character of the symplectic Weil representation is $$ \left|\operatorname{Tr} W_\xi^{E,j}(s)\right| = |\ker(s-1;E)|^{1/2}. $$
